label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (ssrf) is a True Positive. User input ('BenchmarkTest') flows directly to 'endpoint', which is used in the URL sink at line 22. Although a check exists at line 21 to reject IPs starting with 127 (loopback), this mitigation is insufficient. It fails to block other private/internal IP ranges (e.g., 192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x) or cloud metadata services. An attacker can supply an internal IP address to access restricted resources.

evidence.note: User input 'param' assigned to 'endpoint'. 'endpoint' used in URL construction at L22. Weak mitigation at L21 only blocks 127.x.x.x, leaving private ranges exposed.
